title: Visit 3: cough and weight loss
text: Visit 3. Woman, 64, former smoker. Cough for 7 weeks. Tired, lost 6 kg since summer. Chest X-ray 4 weeks ago: no clear finding. Likely post-viral cough. Advised rest.

title: Abdominal pain attributed to weight
text: Man, 58. Abdominal pain and tiredness for 5 weeks, likely related to BMI 38. Advised weight loss and more exercise. No tests ordered.

title: Frequent attender, reassured
text: Woman, 71. Frequent attender, again insists something is wrong with her chest. Says she gets breathless on stairs. Reassured, probably nothing. No follow-up booked.

title: Iron-deficiency anaemia, iron started
text: Man, 67. Hb 98, ferritin low. Feels tired. Iron tablets started. No colonoscopy referral. Control in 3 months.

title: Control: a note with a clear plan
text: Man, 69, smoker. Coughed blood twice this week, cough 4 weeks. Chest CT ordered today, urgent referral to pulmonology sent. Patient told to call if bleeding increases. Review in 1 week.
